task.name: ID Branin
task.description: Local ID Branin task with the primary-source relationship and evaluation changes specified in its protocol notes. FunBO problem-family adaptation: https://arxiv.org/html/2406.04824v1 Appendix C. Local acquisition(mu, sigma, f_best) returns one score per candidate, with sigma a standard deviation; source functions receive predictive variance and return an index. Local GP uses Matérn-5/2 length 0.2, noise 1e-6, five initial observations, a fresh 2000-point uniform candidate pool, 30 total calls and seeds 0,1,2. The paper's per-benchmark kernels, transformed function ensembles and training/search process are not reproduced.
task.contract: acquisition(mu, sigma, f_best) -> one score per candidate point (higher = evaluate next) for a Gaussian-process BO loop on a synthetic function (FunBO contract). Score: mean simple regret after the evaluation budget
